intro: A phasor measurement unit (PMU) measures voltage and current as phasors: the size of the sine wave and its angle against a perfect 50 Hz wave that starts at every UTC second. Its clock comes from GPS, so every value has an exact time stamp. A concentrator (PDC) collects the streams of many PMUs and lines them up by time, to see the whole grid at one instant.

connect.title: Connect
connect.text: The PDC in the control center opens TCP to the PMU on port 4712. The PMU sends nothing until it is asked.

config.title: Ask for the configuration
config.text: Data frames carry numbers only: no names, no units. So the PDC first asks for configuration frame 2 (CFG-2): which values come, in which format, at which rate.

start.title: Start the stream
start.text: Command 2 turns the data frames on. The PMU sends them until the PDC sends command 1 or closes the connection.

stream.title: 50 frames a second
stream.text: Every 20 ms a data frame: time stamp, status, two phasors and the frequency. In 20 ms both angles moved +0.144°, because the grid runs at 50.020 Hz, a little faster than the 50 Hz reference.

event.title: A generator trips
event.text: Somewhere in the grid a large generator trips. The frequency falls: 49.946 Hz, at −0.12 Hz per second. All PMUs time-stamp to the same GPS second, so the PDC can compare their values sample by sample.

frames.cfg2: One PMU, 2 phasors as floats, 50 frames a second

notes.tcp: Plain TCP. Commands and data can share this one connection, as here. A PMU can also send its data over UDP, usually to port 4713, which also allows multicast to several PDCs.

sync-cmd.name: SYNC
sync-cmd.note: 0xAA starts every frame. 0x41: frame type 4 (a command), version 1.

size-18.name: FRAMESIZE
size-18.note: 18 bytes: the whole frame, the check included.

idcode.name: IDCODE
idcode.note: Data stream 7. A command carries the stream it is for; every other frame carries its own.

tq-0.name: Time quality
tq-0.note: 0: the clock is locked to UTC and no leap second is due. If GPS fails, this code says how far off the clock may be.

frac-0.name: FRACSEC
frac-0.note: 0: exactly on the second. This is when the values were measured, not when the frame left.

frac-20.name: FRACSEC
frac-20.note: 0x004E20 = 20 000 µs: 20 ms after the second, one frame later.

cmd-5.name: CMD 5
cmd-5.note: Send configuration frame 2. Other commands: 1 stops the data, 2 starts it, 3 asks for the header frame, 4 for CFG-1.

chk.name: CHK
chk.note: CRC-CCITT of every byte before it: polynomial 0x1021, start value 0xFFFF. A frame with a wrong check is thrown away.

timebase.name: TIME_BASE
timebase.note: 1 000 000 (0x0F4240): FRACSEC counts millionths of a second.

numpmu.name: NUM_PMU
numpmu.note: 1 PMU in this stream. A PDC that forwards many PMUs lists them all here, and its data frames carry one block for each.

pad.name: Padding
pad.note: Spaces: every name in CFG-2 is exactly 16 characters long.

pmuid.name: IDCODE
pmuid.note: The ID of this PMU's data: 7.

format.name: FORMAT
format.note: 0x000B: phasors as floats in polar form (magnitude and angle), FREQ and DFREQ as floats too.

counts.name: PHNMR · ANNMR · DGNMR
counts.note: 2 phasors, 0 analog values, 0 digital status words. With FORMAT, this fixes the size of every data frame.

chnam-v.name: CHNAM
chnam-v.note: The name of phasor 1: V1 POS SEQ, the positive-sequence voltage.

chnam-i.name: CHNAM
chnam-i.note: Phasor 2: I1 POS SEQ, the positive-sequence current.

phunit-v.name: PHUNIT
phunit-v.note: First byte 0: phasor 1 is a voltage. The other 3 bytes scale 16-bit integers (300 000 × 10⁻⁵ V per bit); with floats they are ignored.

phunit-i.name: PHUNIT
phunit-i.note: First byte 1: phasor 2 is a current. 3 000 × 10⁻⁵ A per bit, also unused with floats.

fnom.name: FNOM
fnom.note: Bit 0 set: a 50 Hz grid. Clear, it would mean 60 Hz.

cfgcnt.name: CFGCNT
cfgcnt.note: 3: the PMU's configuration has been changed 3 times. The PDC compares it to know whether its copy is current.

rate.name: DATA_RATE
rate.note: 50 frames per second: one every 20 ms.

stat.name: STAT
stat.note: 0x0000: data good, PMU in sync with UTC, sorted by time stamp, no trigger, no configuration change coming.

v1-mag-0.name: V1 magnitude
v1-mag-0.note: 89 120 V, a float. Phase to neutral: about 154 kV between phases.

v1-ang-0.name: V1 angle
v1-ang-0.note: −0.21642 rad = −12.400°, against the 50 Hz reference wave.

dfreq-0.name: DFREQ
dfreq-0.note: The rate of change of frequency: 0.000 Hz/s.

i1-mag-ev.name: I1 magnitude
i1-mag-ev.note: 455.0 A: the line now carries more power.

freq-ev.name: FREQ
freq-ev.note: 49.946 Hz: below 50 Hz, because the grid lost a generator.

facts.standard: IEEE C37.118.2-2011 (the frames); the measurement itself: IEC/IEEE 60255-118-1
facts.between: PMU → PDC, PDC → PDC and applications
facts.transport: TCP 4712 for commands, and often data; UDP 4713 for data
facts.security: None: a CRC only. Use a separate network or a VPN. IEC 61850-90-5 is the secured alternative.
facts.speed: 10 to 50 frames per second on a 50 Hz grid. Time within about 1 µs of UTC: 1 µs is 0.018° at 50 Hz.

tips: Data frames carry no names and no units. If the PMU's setup changes and the PDC keeps the old CFG-2, it reads wrong values without an error. STAT bit 10 warns before a change: read CFG-2 again.
Check the time quality before you trust an angle. When GPS is lost, STAT bit 13 is set and the angles drift: 1 ms of clock error is 18° at 50 Hz.
The IDCODE must match on both sides. A PDC set up for stream 7 ignores frames that carry another number.
Angles are only comparable at the same time stamp. A PDC waits a set time for late frames: too short and it drops data, too long and every display lags.

timing.title: Every frame is tied to the UTC second
timing.note: The PMU measures at fixed moments: 0, 20, 40 ms … after each UTC second, as its GPS clock marks it. The frame leaves a little later, here 30 ms. The time stamp is the moment of the measurement, so a PDC can line up PMUs whose frames arrive at different times.

playground.encoder: C37.118 sends floats most significant byte first (ABCD). 89120 is the V1 magnitude of the first data frame: 47 AE 10 00.
